environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed via SAM template, fronted by API Gateway (HTTP API type) with no request validation. Lambda runs in a VPC with a NAT gateway providing internet access. RDS MySQL instance in same VPC with security group allowing inbound 3306 from Lambda's security group. Lambda execution role has AmazonRDSFullAccess and AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole. No WAF attached to the API Gateway stage.

config.db_user_privileges: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on app_db.*
